articleTitle: Short-Term Electric Load Forecasting Model based on PSO-BP
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: To improve the accuracy of load forecasting and improve the efficiency of power generation, a PSO-BP model is proposed. Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) is used to optimize the parameters such as parameter weight and learning rate of the BP neural network, and then the PSO-BP model is used for load forecasting. The algorithm is verified on the load data set constructed in this paper, and the feasibility of the combined algorithm is verified. The prediction error is 3%. It can be seen from the experimental results that compared with BP and LSTM neural networks, the RMSE values of the PSO-BP algorithm are increased by 63.6 % and 54.90 % respectively, which can achieve higher prediction accuracy.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of a Water Quality Monitoring System in Aquaculture Based on IoT Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: To effectively solve the problems such as high labor costs and sloppy water quality monitoring in the aquaculture industry at this stage, and also improve the development of intelligent, informative, and smart water quality monitoring in aquaculture, a system based on the Internet of Things (IoT) technology is proposed, which can directly control the monitoring devices in Ali Cloud IoT platform and obtain water quality monitoring data. In addition, for the problem that the sensor monitoring data error rate is large, based on simulation experiments, the Kalman filter algorithm is applied to the data processing aspect of the system so that the data monitored by the sensor is more accurate. The laboratory and the actual scene test show that the system studied in this paper can directly control and read the water quality data in the Ali Cloud IOT platform, and the error rate of the obtained water quality environmental data is small, which provides valuable information for aquaculture industry production and scientific research.

articleTitle: FedAvg-DWA: A Novel Algorithm for Enhanced Fraud Detection in Federated Learning Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: The research on credit card fraud detection can protect consumers and banks from economic losses. The current research direction mainly focuses on improving the efficiency and accuracy of fraud detection using machine learning technology. This paper mainly studies how to use federated learning to improve the efficiency and effect of credit card fraud detection. The experiment uses the credit card transaction data of European cardholders and uses the Dirichlet distribution to randomly and proportionally allocate the sample data to 10 simulated banks. In response to the limited prediction accuracy of existing federated learning algorithms such as FedAvg (Federated Averaging) for imbalanced data, this paper proposes a FedAvg-DWA algorithm (Federated Averaging with Distance-based Weighted Aggregation). This algorithm considers the weight of small class samples and innovates in the model distance aspect of the aggregation strategy. The experiment achieved good results, providing a new method for dealing with the problem of class imbalance.

articleTitle: A WGAN-based Missing Data Causal Discovery Method
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: The state-of-the-art causal discovery algorithms are typically based on complete observed data. However, in reality, technical issues, human errors, and data collection methods among other reasons result in missing data. The methods for handling missing data mainly involve statistical and machine learning approaches, where statistical methods are simple and practical, while machine learning methods offer higher accuracy. The typical approach for causal structure discovery in the presence of missing data involves two steps: First, applying missing data imputation algorithms to address the issue of missing data, and then using causal discovery algorithms to identify the causal structure. However, this two-step approach is suboptimal because imputing missing data may introduce biases in the underlying data distribution, making it challenging to accurately assess causal effects between variables. This paper proposes an iterative approach based on generative models for both missing data imputation and causal structure discovery. This approach incorporates an architecture based on Wasserstein generative adversarial networks and autoencoders (AE) to respectively impute missing data and output the causal structure. Through extensive experiments comparing against various state-of-the-art baseline algorithms, the effectiveness and superiority of this method are validated, providing valuable insights for further research on causal structures in the context of missing data.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-Enhanced Fingerprint Generation and Security Verification in the Context of Siamese Network Matching Models
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Fingerprint recognition, a widely adopted technology in various domains, confronts significant challenges in both technical and practical realms. Therefore, it is essential to develop an effective algorithm to improve the accuracy of fingerprint recognition. In this study, a novel method is proposed to generate fake fingerprint images by Deep Convolution Generative Adversarial Networks (DCGAN) network, utilizing FVC2002 and FVC2004 as the dataset. Furthermore, a dataset consisting of 6, 000 fingerprint pairs, with the first 3, 000 pairs collected from the same individual and the remaining 3, 000 pairs from different individuals, is employed to train a Siamese Network. Finally, the real fingerprint image and the generated fingerprint image are used as two inputs to the Siamese Network to verify whether any two fingerprint images can be incorrectly matched. Experimental results indicate that DCGAN has an excellent ability to generate fingerprint images, although a small portion of the generated images have defects, which may be caused by the model training the blank part of the images as important features, etc. Additionally, the security verification experiment employing the Siamese Network reveals potential vulnerabilities in the fingerprint recognition system, possibly stemming from the network’s focus on localized similarities between the two input fingerprint images.

articleTitle: A Novel Cassava Pest Identification System Based on YOLOV5
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: As an important food and industrial raw material, cassava is widely cultivated worldwide. However, cassava plants are often attacked by various pests and diseases, resulting in significant yield losses. Therefore, timely identification of cassava plant pests and diseases is crucial. The accuracy of existing cassava pest detection technology needs improvement, especially when farmers capture images of cassava plants in different lighting and equipment conditions. These factors can affect the quality of the image thereby affecting the recognition results. To address this issue, a new cassava pest recognition system based on the improved YOLO-V5 algorithm is developed. By incorporating the attention mechanism module SE into YOLO-V5, the system's focus on the characteristics of the leaves has been enhanced, making it easier to detect pests and diseases. Moreover, the system is suitable for real-time environments and is easy to implement and use, making it possible to deploy it in various terminals and networked devices. Our experimental results demonstrate that the system performs well in detecting cassava pests and diseases.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a Stack-based SoC Supporting Real-time Forth Operating System
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Aiming to fully harness the performance of existing real-time Forth operating systems, a 32-bit stack-based SoC has been designed. The SoC is interconnected through the Wishbone bus, with the stack processor serving as the master device and peripheral devices as slaves. The arbitration method employed is round-robin. The stack processor is designed with a four-stage pipeline, and the instruction set is extended and improved based on the J1 instruction set. Experimental results reveal that at the maximum clock frequency, when compared to the stack processor currently supporting real-time Forth operating systems, the stack-based SoC exhibits significant enhancements in three crucial real-time performance metrics: maximal interrupt latency, task context switching time, and real-time task response time. These improvements are evidenced by achieving values of 2.36us, 1.42us, and 4.93us, respectively. As a result, the stack-based SoC effectively unleashes the capabilities of the Forth real-time operating system.

articleTitle: Detection of Speckle Defects in Alumina Ceramic Balls Based on MobileNetV3-YOLOv5
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Aiming at the current alumina ceramic ball speckle defect detection algorithm in practical applications, such as low detection accuracy and slow detection speed, a fast detection method of ceramic ball surface defects based on the improved YOLOv5 is proposed. The ceramic ball image data is first obtained using the camera, then processed to standardize the image size, rotated, added noise, and subjected to other data enhancement operations. The data is then annotated using data annotation software to create the dataset, which is then used to improve the backbone network of the improved YOLOv5s using MobileNetV3. When parameters are checked, it is discovered that the upgraded network model's detection effect is noticeably better than YOLOv5's, with an average identification rate of more than 64% and a detection time of roughly 203ms. A thorough investigation reveals that the method's spot defect detection effect for alumina ceramic ball production is superior, and it has some practical utility for the batch production line.

articleTitle: A Path Planning Method for UAV Inspection of Wind Turbines
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Traditional wind turbine inspection mainly relies on manual inspection, which has the advantages of intuitive and reliable inspection feedback, but only the inspection task is easily affected by weather and natural environment, as make it difficult to be carried out occasionally. It is necessary to introduce the rapid development of UAV autonomous inspection technology for wind turbine inspection tasks. However, UAV autonomous inspection faces the modeling problem caused by the stop position of wind turbines, Additionally, the inspection route planning is based on the experience of operators. The above reasons make it difficult to guarantee the inspection efficiency. In order to solve these problems, an automatic route planning algorithm for wind turbines was proposed. First, the panoramic view of wind turbines was collected by UAV, and the blade tips were automatically identified and located based on vision. Then, the patrol route and relay route were automatically generated, and the safety was checked by collision detection algorithm. Finally, the patrol tests of wind turbines were carried out. The results show that this method can improve the level and efficiency of automatic inspection of wind turbines.

articleTitle: A Multi-dimensional Generic Evaluation Framework for the Security of Large Language Models
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: In light of the widespread adoption of large language models, their susceptibility to security vulnerabilities cannot be overlooked. As a result, it has become imperative to evaluate their proficiency in addressing issues such as toxicity, bias, and disinformation. However, current research focused on appraising and mitigating security risks has predominantly concentrated on specific facets, leading to disparities in evaluation criteria. In contrast, there has been relatively limited attention given to multidimensional and universal frameworks for security evaluation. In this context, this paper delves into the realm of generic evaluation frameworks for security that offer support for cross-language and multi-category analysis. We underscore the existing challenges associated with prominent large language models concerning security issues and develop a comprehensive test data set to furnish researchers with a tool for quantifying security aspects. Through comprehensive evaluations across three major benchmark tests, we identify distinct strengths and weaknesses exhibited by each open source large language model to varying degrees. By employing a multi-dimensional security evaluation framework, we can attain a more holistic comprehension of the performance exhibited by each model across diverse security dimensions. This approach holds significant value in advancing the domain of security research and facilitating the practical application of language models.

articleTitle: Improved Streaming Computing Method Based on IoT Components of Virtual Power Plant
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: The virtual power plant is an important part of the new power system. Its IoT components need to collect and process energy equipment measurement data in real time, which inevitably uses stream computing. This paper improves the original streaming computing method. By sorting the data according to the reference relationship, it avoids the centralized storage of a large amount of data, reduces the concurrent access to the data, and realizes that each step is parallel; by splitting the data, the data processing in the branch stream is simplified; by encapsulating computing units, the free distribution of computing on distributed computing nodes is realized, avoiding the bottleneck limitation of a single node, and realizing lateral expansion. This ensures stable system operation and efficient use of computing resources.

articleTitle: A Study on Scratch Defect Detection of Ceramic Blades Based on Improved YOLOv5
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: This paper suggests an enhanced YOLOv5 network segmentation technique to address the issue of low efficiency and accuracy of standard detection algorithms and increase the automation degree of scratch detection of ceramic blades. The addition of an attention module improves the performance and accuracy of the YOLOv5 network. It also increases the network’s concentration on important features and lessens the impact of unimportant features. To improve the network’s ability to extract more information from the image, the image dataset is expanded. By using feature maps of different scales for object detection, the method of multi-scale feature fusion can be further improved. Compared with the original YOLOv5 algorithm, the detection accuracy of the improved YOLOv5 network is increased by 7.2% to 0.628. And the network training time is shorter, and the accuracy of the detection of ceramic blade scratches is higher, which proves that the algorithm of this paper has application value in the field of ceramic blade scratch detection.

articleTitle: Transformer Fault Diagnosis Based on DGA Information Fusion
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: This paper proposes a transformer fault diagnosis method based on the fusion of Dissolved Gas Analysis (DGA) information. The method aims to address the issues of uncertainty, redundancy, and singularity in traditional fault diagnosis methods for transformers. By utilizing the Principle Component Analysis (PCA) technique, the 16 gas ratio features are effectively reduced in dimensionality. The dimensionally reduced feature parameters are then utilized as inputs for Extreme Learning Machines (ELM), Backpropagation (BP) neural networks, and Support Vector Machines (SVM). Furthermore, the decision results obtained from these networks are fused using the Dempster-Shafer (D-S) evidence theory to yield more accurate fault diagnosis outcomes. Experimental validation demonstrates that the proposed method effectively extracts valuable information from DGA data and significantly enhances the reliability and accuracy of fault recognition, surpassing the performance of single algorithm approaches.

articleTitle: Identification of User-transformer Relationship Based on Dynamic Time Warping Algorithm and Two-stage Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: With the continuous promotion of new power system construction, a higher requirement is proposed for low-voltage district management. Problems such as abnormal data collection, line loss caused by user-transformer relationship chaos aren’t to be ignored. To solve the problem, this paper proposed a two-stage clustering algorithm for user-transformer relationship identification. First, the similarity of users’ voltage time series curve is calculated by dynamic time warping algorithm. Second, propose a two-stage clustering algorithm based on the self-organizing feature mapping algorithm and K-means algorithm. With this two- stage clustering algorithm, the similarity of users’ voltage time series curve could be clustered rapidly. Users connected to the same transformer that have similar voltage time series curve theoretically could be identified to be the same type, therefore achieving the goal of identifying user-transformer relationship intelligently. Finally, simulations and analysis are performed on the basis of actual low-voltage district. Results prove the effectiveness of the method proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: Design of Fall Detection System Based on Infrared -Visible Camera and Internet of Things Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: According to statistics, the incidence of falls among the elderly in China is as high as 30%, and falls have become one of the most important reasons threatening the safety and health of the elderly. A deep learning-based infrared-visible fall remote alarm system is designed to address the problem that it is difficult to detect falls of elderly people in time, resulting in high death and disability rates. The system deploys infrared or visible light cameras for different indoor scenarios to balance “privacy” “accuracy” and “comfort” and is equipped with a voice recognition module. The basic information interaction function is realized by IOT technology. The experimental results show that the fall alarm system operates stably, with good performance and reliable data transmission.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis for a Recommending System Based on Partially Observed Markov Decision Processes
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Recommender systems have become an essential tool for online platforms to provide personalized recommendations to their users. Among various recommendation techniques, deep learning-based approaches have attracted significant attention due to their ability to capture complex user-item interactions and provide accurate recommendations. In this paper, we propose a new recommendation method that combines the Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (DDPG) algorithm and Long Short-Term Memory (GRU and RNN) networks. The goal is to improve the recommendation performance in the partially observable. Markov decision process (POMDP) scenario, where user preferences and interactions with items evolve over time.

articleTitle: Research on Federated Learning Security Defense Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: In a federated learning environment, data interaction and sharing between nodes are inevitable. Malicious attackers may tamper with the data of certain nodes or even train models, posing a security threat to entities. Among these security attacks, backdoor attacks are the most covert. On the basis of existing research, this article designs a federated learning convergence wheel backdoor defense method and applies it to the field of vehicle networking. This method can effectively defend against backdoor attacks.

articleTitle: Lightweight IoT-based Authentication Scheme in 5G Circumstance
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: With the popularization of internet devices and 5G technology, the Internet of Things has become one of the most popular technologies today. However, the massive amount of data generated by various intelligent devices is one of the biggest problems in IoT scenarios. In order to solve the problems of data theft and network congestion in large-scale IoT, scholars have quickly studied authentication technologies in IoT and 5G environments. However, there is currently no achievement that combines data security and low transmission latency. In this study, we propose an authentication scheme based on a combination of IoT architecture and 5G servers. To solve the problem of excessive authentication overhead caused by massive terminal access to the network, we adopt lightweight encryption modules such as one-way hash functions and XOR operations. This reduces the computational burden and makes the proposed authentication scheme suitable for objects with limited resources, such as sensors or IoT devices.

articleTitle: Research and Improvement of Secure Hash Algorithm Based on MD5
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: With the continuous development of the Internet, the MD5 algorithm is widely used in the field of computer security. Aiming at the shortcomings of the traditional MD5 salting algorithm, this paper proposes an improved MD5 salting algorithm, which is verified to improve the security of data.

articleTitle: Risk Assessment Model of Aquatic Product Cold Chain Logistics Based on PSO-BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: The risk assessment model of cold chain logistics of aquatic products was established by PSO-BP neural network, and the risk index of cold chain logistics of aquatic products was determined. The model training results show that the risk of refrigerated truck transport is the highest and the risk of public event is the lowest in the cold chain logistics of aquatic products. Strengthen the updating of refrigerated truck equipment technology, do a good job in the maintenance and maintenance of vehicles and chillers, avoid damage caused by improper operation, and promote the stable development of cold chain logistics.

articleTitle: An Improved Abnormal Power Consumption Detection System Based on Federated Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: In the power business scenario, the existing abnormal power consumption detection system based on federated learning generally uses a single encryption algorithm to encrypt information during data transmission, which has certain limitations in efficiency and security. In this paper, we propose an improved abnormal power consumption detection system based on federated learning, which optimizes the encryption algorithm for the actual power business scenario, and adds the mixed use of multiple algorithms. The results show that in the actual power business scenario, compared with the traditional abnormal power consumption detection system based on federated learning, the system can better improve the efficiency of model training.

articleTitle: MNVLD: Violent Language Detection Model with Optimized Loss Function
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Violent language on the Internet has become a serious problem on social platforms, posing a threat to users’ sense of security and a conducive communication environment. Most existing methods focus on creating violent language dictionaries and classifying texts using support vector machines (SVM) and naive Bayesian techniques. However, these methods face challenges when confronted with tens of thousands of text comments or commenters using obscure words. Additionally, the current network violence language detection technology performs poorly in multi-domain settings. This paper aims to enhance the MFND model in the context of rumor detection. We propose the MNVLD model, which incorporates an appropriate loss function based on the characteristics of the network violence language dataset, to effectively detect violent language across multiple domains.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of Multi-Core Stack Processor Based on AXI Bus
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: As the complexity of embedded systems continues to rise, enhancing the performance of stack processors and exploring the value of multi-core stack processors have become imperative. Building upon the research of a single-core stack processor model, this paper designs a multi-core stack processor model based on the AXI (Advanced eXtensible Interface) bus. Starting with the J1 single-core stack processor model, we introduce modules such as the AXI bus standard, finite state machine, and bus communication interface to construct a single-core stack processor model using the AXI bus. Taking this single-core model as the core, we achieve multi-core interconnection through shared bus communication. We design the Forth instruction system, memory units, and bus arbiter. Ultimately, a multi-core stack processor model based on the AXI bus is constructed. Prototypes of dual-core and quad-core multi-core stack processors are implemented on FPGA, both operating steadily at a frequency of 100MHz. Performance testing and validation are conducted on the Xilinx XC7A100T development board. The experiments demonstrate that the designed multi-core stack processor structure meets the design goals of high performance and low power consumption.

articleTitle: A Variant of the Sine Cosine Algorithm for Engineering Optimization Design
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: The design of pressure vessels is a constrained optimization problem that is influenced by many real-world standards and specifications. It involves multiple variables and multiple constraints. The existence of real constraints can make the solution space complex, leading to multiple local optima and making the search for the global optimum very difficult. Metaheuristic algorithms provide effective solutions for constrained optimization problems. The Sine Cosine Algorithm (SCA) is an optimization algorithm based on sine and cosine functions. However, like most metaheuristic algorithms, the traditional SCA has some shortcomings, such as high dependence on the initial solution and the tendency to get trapped in local optima. In this paper, we address these issues by using the Singer chaotic mapping to initialize the solution space of the population and introducing quantum theory to improve the search mechanism of the SCA algorithm. We propose a variant of SCA called CQ-SCA for optimizing the weight design of pressure vessels. Experimental results show that the design scheme obtained by CQ-SCA is more suitable than other algorithms.

articleTitle: Research on Typical Pipeline Damage Identification Method for Ultrasonic Guided Wave Based on Two-Dimensional Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: This paper proposes a two-dimensional convolutional neural network model based on improved ResNeXt for ultrasonic guide wave pipeline structural health monitoring and typical damage classification. The time-frequency analysis technique is used to convert the ultrasonic guide wave echo signal into a time-frequency map, which is then learned and classified by the improved ResNeXt model. Experimental results show that the improved model is superior to the traditional ResNet50 and ResNeXt50 models. This method has good application prospects in the field of pipeline structural health monitoring, but it still needs to be verified and evaluated in a practical environment. At the same time, optimizing the model structure and expanding the dataset scale are also future research directions.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Detection Technology of LIDAR Morphology for Coal Ash storage in Complex Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Aiming at the high dust and low light operating environment inside the Ash storage, this paper proposes a three-dimensional topography scanning system of the Coal Ash storage based on single-line LIDAR, which uses the characteristics of laser scanning technology with high measurement accuracy and strong anti-interference ability to realize the detection of the inside of the Coal Ash storage, and uses the rotating single-line LIDAR scanning plane to realize the scanning of the actual space scene. According to the structural characteristics of the 3D scanning device and the laser measurement principle, the system error source is analyzed and the error compensation of the overall system is carried out, and the original point cloud data is obtained at the same time by controlling the working process of the scanning device through the upper computer. Scanning experiments show that the scanning system proposed in this paper can collect real and effective point cloud data.

articleTitle: Delay Optimization Offloading Strategy under Cloud-Edge-End Collaboration
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: For B5G/6G, the degree of intelligence of Internet of Things (IoT) terminals has gradually improved, and emerging intelligent applications have higher requirements for task delay. The multi-tier computing network framework has become the research focus to meet the requirements of the scenario. In this article, we investigate the computation offloading scheme in the cloud-edge-end collaborative scenario and propose a joint strategy of computation offload and resource allocation to optimize the task delay. Then, the optimization problem is formulated as a nonlinear programming problem. Based on the constrained conditions, the problem is decomposed into two sub-problems: computation offloading and resource allocation, which are solved using the simulated annealing (SA) algorithm and convex optimization, respectively. Finally, simulation results demonstrate that the proposed collaboration offloading scheme is efficient, and the delay optimization outperforms other offloading schemes.

articleTitle: Enhancement Method of Reservoir Numerical Simulation Based on Generative Adversarial Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: In practical simulation research of fluid flow in reservoir porous media, the demand for computational resources in numerical simulation greatly limits its accuracy and practical usage. While the numerical solution of Darcy flow’s PDE is based on the idea of discretizing the continuous geology models into an upscaled grid to proximate the analytical solution. The grid size which can significantly affect the computational effort becomes an essential factor. In our research, we borrow the idea from super-resolution technique to map the relationship between the simulation results by coarse and fine grids and propose a simulation enhancement method based on GAN structure. The designed network called petrophysical constrained simulation generative adversarial network (PCSGAN) employs RRDB and attention mechanism to achieve the above target. Different from traditional super-resolution methods, PCSGAN innovatively uses the petrophysical grid data to constrain and guide the enhancement procedure to improve its accuracy. To demonstrate the PCSGAN’s ability, we design some simulation experiments by finite volume of the 2D anisotropy reservoir models. Each model has two scale sizes, the fine one is 16 times larger than the coarse one. The target of PCSGAN is to enhance the simulation result from coarse gird to match the one from fine grid. From these experiments, the effect of PCSGAN is fully evaluated, the analysis and discussion of these results are also provided.

articleTitle: Weight Distribution Based Model Compression Method for Object Detection System
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Artificial intelligence-based object detection is an essential field in computer vision applications such as autonomous driving, security surveillance, medical image analysis, intelligent transportation, and human-computer interaction. However, such state-of-the-art algorithm is computing and resources intensive, which limits its deployment especially on resources constrained devices such mobile phones, drones, and autonomous vehicles. In this paper, we propose a compression method to overcome such bottleneck. Our approach reduces the computing complexity by automatically zeroing out certain percentage of weights in convolutional layers. Through extensive experiments on the well-known YOLOv5s model, 60% computing can be saved during the inference process without sacrificing the (mean Average Precision) mAP.

articleTitle: The Boundaries of Copyright Protection for Deep Learning Technologies of Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: With the continuous progress in the field of artificial intelligence, the breadth and depth of deep learning technology is being strengthened. Although the technology itself is neutral, it is necessary to pay attention to the boundaries of the use of data and to comply with legal regulations in the process of practical application. Regarding the “data mining” and other types of behaviour in deep learning, a comprehensive judgment should be made based on the reproduction right in the field of copyright law, and at the same time, the dissemination effect formed by the cumulative technical characteristics of the reproduction of deep learning technology should be analysed, so that whether or not to obtain the reproduction legally should be taken as the basis of the infringement judgment. Ultimately, the prohibited areas of copyright use and the boundaries of protection should be clarified to avoid the risk of violation of law and promote the sustainable development of the industry.

articleTitle: Talent Recommendation Model of School-enterprise Cooperation Based on Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: With the development of big data, artificial intelligence and other technologies, the research on the construction of intelligent human recommendation environment has gradually formed the characteristics of self-adaptation and personalization. As for discussing the problem of low utilization rate of human resources big data, the internal factor mechanism of talent big data system selection intention based on data technology matching is not clear enough. Starting from the two sub-dimensions of data prediction technology fit and information recommendation context fit, this paper studies the willingness of human resource practitioners to choose big data human resource system. The explanation mechanism of perceived value was put forward. According to the characteristics of talent demand, the clustering recommendation method is divided into prediction part and recommendation part. The recommendation part mainly solves the problems of data sparsity and cold start. The attributes of the acquired user data are extracted. The knowledge map of user demand service domain is constructed. Then, the knowledge map of cooperative enterprises is clustered according to the graph segmentation theory. Each data cluster is imported into the random forest model for training. With the potential of network representation learning in structural feature extraction over time, nodes in heterogeneous networks are transformed into low-dimensional vectors through network representation learning model to solve the problem of node similarity in large-scale structural networks. It will promote the cooperation between enterprises and universities, and will also enhance the innovation ability of intelligent recommendation of human resources in school-enterprise cooperation.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence-based Recognition of Wear and Corrosion on Steel Surfaces
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Based on the commonly used steel wear and tear identification method is limited by many factors and the accuracy is not high enough to be stable, this paper adopts a new artificial intelligence algorithm to improve the accuracy of steel wear and corrosion identification. In this paper, a total of six neural network models such as CNN, VGG, etc. are used to classify a total of 1,800 steel photos with six different degrees of wear and tear, and after the model construction and parameter debugging, we get the classification accuracy of CNN, InceptionResNetV2, and Xception models is higher, and MobileNetV2 model has higher sensitivity to the scratch category. The conclusion that the sensitivity of images is higher, using these emerging AI algorithms of deep learning is an effective way to improve the accuracy of steel wear and corrosion recognition.

articleTitle: Cloud Resource Scheduling Strategy Based on Improved PSO Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: The scheduling of cloud computing resources is a key technology in cloud computing. A particle swarm optimization algorithm based on family relationship selection (FS-PSO) is proposed to address the drawback of particle swarm optimization algorithm being prone to falling into local optima. By introducing a family selection strategy, the limitations of the PSO algorithm are compensated for, to improve the optimization efficiency and solving ability of the algorithm. Simulation experiments have shown that the FS-PSO algorithm has stronger adaptability, faster convergence speed, and stronger global search ability. It can effectively improve the utilization of cloud computing resources and has good application value.

articleTitle: Application of Nonnegative Matrix Factorization in Intelligent Patrol Inspection of Substations
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Non negative matrix factorization (NMF) is a very popular data dimensionality reduction technique in recent years, which can reduce dimensionality while preserving the corresponding spatial relationships and internal structures of the original data. However, the feature variables extracted by traditional NMF algorithms are often not sparse. Therefore, a new sparse constrained non negative matrix factorization (SCNMF) algorithm is proposed. Firstly, based on the alternating constrained least squares method for solving the NMF problem, sparsity constraints are applied to the coefficient matrix H to obtain a more sparse representation of the data. Subsequently, a non negative double singular value decomposition (NDSVD) method was proposed to initialize the SCNMF algorithm to improve its efficiency. Finally, the proposed algorithm is applied to the image processing of a transformer in a certain substation. The experimental results show that the convergence and computational accuracy of the SCNMF algorithm are significantly better than traditional NMF algorithms, and the effectiveness of image processing is also better than the NMF method.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a Sorting Robot System Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: In the context of intelligent manufacturing, the application of robots in industrial production has become an unstoppable development trend. A deep learning workshop parts sorting robot target recognition method is proposed to address the problems of low average confidence and poor recognition performance when using the current method to identify robot targets due to the lack of detailed analysis of the movement patterns of the sorting robot. This method extracts the feature vector values of the target to be detected by analyzing the motion laws of the sorting robot; Establishing a target recognition model based on deep learning theory, constructing a feature extraction network through separable linear convolution, utilizing the separability and redundancy of convolution layer feature information to reduce the model’s parameter and computational complexity, and reduce deployment costs; In order to further improve the accuracy of rotation detection, a constant factor based on ArIoU is introduced into the regression loss function to solve the periodicity problem of rotation angle, which improves the efficiency and robustness of visual detection in work piece sorting. The experimental results indicate that this system can effectively achieve robot sorting effects, and it has good reference value for researching robot sorting and automation.

articleTitle: An Edge Porting Method for Object Detection Networks Based on Knowledge Distillation
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: In order to meet the problem that the UAV-borne edge terminal has low computational power and cannot deploy complex models. A knowledge distillation method based on yolov4 and attention mechanism is designed, and a model lightweight transplantation scheme is realized by introducing teacher network and student network. Experiments show that the distillation method can greatly improve the efficiency of the model while maintaining the accuracy of the model.

articleTitle: Research on Ship AIS Data Analysis Based on Stream Computing and Virtual Fence
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: With the development of smart maritime construction, ship virtual fences have been applied in areas such as ship entry and exit, bridge area navigation safety, and checkpoint management. By combining the ship virtual fence and stream computing technology, a real-time ship automatic identification system (AIS) data analysis platform is developed. It tracks the position and navigation status of ships in the virtual fence area. This platform has been validated in the Jiangsu section of the Yangtze River basin, and it effectively improves the intelligent level of maritime supervision.

articleTitle: Short Text Classification Model Based on DeBERTa-DPCNN
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Aiming at the sparsity, real-time and irregularity of news headline text, a Chinese short text classification algorithm based on DeBERTa-DPCNN is proposed. The short text vector is extracted through DeBERTa’s attention decoupling mechanism and the enhanced mask decoder, and the short text information is extracted deeply with the help of DPCNN to obtain more global features of the text. The F1 value of the comprehensive evaluation index of the DeBERTa-DPCNN fusion model is 5.12%, 1.03%, 0.47%, 13.68%, 4.44%, 3.3%, 2.78%, 0.12% higher than that of the BERT model, RoBERT model, XLNet model, joint DPCNN network model, BERT-DPCNN model, ERNIE-DPCNN model, ERNIE-DPCNN-BiGRU model and DeBERTa model respectively.

articleTitle: Feature-Aligned Feature Pyramid Network and Center-Assisted Anchor Matching for Small Face Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: The performance of face detection has made great progress with the rapid development of deep learning. However, small faces only contain an extremely limited number of pixels, which makes them suffer from poor feature representation and low-quality positive anchors. These problems make small face detection still a highly challenging task In this paper, we conduct an in-depth study from the perspective of feature learning and anchor matching and present a small-scale aware face detector (SFDet), which can accurately detect small faces. Specifically, we first propose a feature alignment module (FAM), which learns the semantic transformation offset and adaptively upsamples features using it as a guide. FAM can construct a powerful feature pyramid to learn more discriminative and robust feature representation of small faces. Then, we design an IoU-and-center based anchor matching strategy (ICAMS), which introduces center point information as a new matching metric to complement the traditional intersection over union (IoU) metric and simultaneously uses these two metrics in the anchor matching stage. ICAMS can ensure the generation of high-quality positive anchors of small faces. Comprehensive experiments are conducted on two challenging face detection datasets, and the results demonstrate the effectiveness of our method.

articleTitle: Fault Analysis and Research on Elevator Clustering Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: With the rapid development of China's economy, elevators have become a basic tool in daily life, and the safety hazards brought by elevators are also of great concern. It is urgent to use big data technology to mine existing data and obtain the corresponding laws of elevator faults. This article studies typical analysis methods using big data mining technology, analyzes the impact of elevator clustering related feature information on in use elevator equipment faults, and predicts typical elevator faults based on elevator information data, thereby providing better services for elevator fault prediction.

articleTitle: A Deep-Learning-based Cardiac Sound Segmentation Method for Smart Auscultation Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Automatic phonocardiogram (PCG) segmentation is important for smart cardiac auscultation. One cardiac sound cycle includes the first heart sound (S1), systole, the second heart sound (S2), and diastole. Due to individual variation or pathological changes, PCG may show fixed or unfixed length of interval, retaining or vanishing of S1 or S2, or various abnormal components. E. g., systolic murmurs in aortic stenosis (AS) may also lead to disappearance of S2, hindering locating S1 and S2 in traditional cardiac sound segmentation methods. In this paper, based on our established R-CNN-style deep-learning model, a novel PCG cycle segmentation method is proposed. Firstly, multi-scale temporal region proposals are extracted from Shannon-entropy envelope. Secondly, a convolutional neural network (CNN) for classification and regression of temporal region proposals is established, where the backbone network is DenseNet with attention mechanism. Finally, non-maximum suppression (NMS) algorithm is employed to ensure the most accurate result from the PCG segments of temporal region proposals. The proposed method has been proved robust on multiple databases, including 95.92% accuracy on our own database, 95.52% on PhysioNet 2016, and 92.32% on PASCAL. Specifically, the proposed method can achieve 90.41% accuracy on AS PCG recordings.

articleTitle: A Multi-Agent Action Prediction Algorithm Incorporating Decision Trees and Residual Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: The strategies of traditional multi-agent are difficult to understand from the outside through human observation due to the large joint state space and complex action behavior. Therefore, this paper investigates the utilization of expert log data in multi-agent and proposes a method for fitting strategies with residual networks based on expert datasets. The method can predict the agent’s forthcoming action and action parameters from the current state, so that the problem of predicting the opponent’s action in real time can be solved by using the expert data obtained from a large number of simulation environments. Results obtained from the RoboCup2D soccer simulation environment demonstrate that the algorithm effectively predicts agent actions and fits strategy models for different teams.

articleTitle: Wire Arc Additive Manufacturing Microstructure Pore Defect Detection Algorithm Based on Improved YOLOv5
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Pore defects are one of the main forms of microstructural defects in wire arc additive manufacturing (WAAM), which can lead to degradation of the mechanical properties of WAAM components. To swiftly and accurately detect pore defects, this paper proposes a microstructure pore defect detection model for WAAM based on YOLOv5s. Firstly, the detection accuracy of detecting tiny pores in high-resolution images is improved by introducing the Replkdext module to replace the C3 module in the backbone network. Secondly, to address the issues of false positives and false negatives related to tiny pore defects, the CIOU loss function is replaced by the Normalized Gaussian Wasserstein Distance loss function (NWDLoss). Finally, the Convolutional Block Attention Module (CBAM) is introduced into the neck network to enhance the model's capability to focus on tiny pore defects in images and improve feature expression. To validate the effectiveness of the model, performance testing is conducted on a self-built dataset of arc additive microstructure porosity defects in this study. The experimental results indicate that the improved model not only improves detection accuracy but also enhances detection speed.

articleTitle: Research on Target Detection Network Based on improved Swin-DETR
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: The Swin-DETR network model based on the improved DETR model is proposed to solve the problem that the resolution ratio of small targets is low in complex environment and it is not easy to be detected. Swin-T architecture is introduced into the backbone network of DETR model to improve the model’s deep extraction ability of parts of image features. Meanwhile, CBAM module is integrated into the backbone network. Through the fusion attention mechanism in CBAM module, the identification accuracy of small targets in the backbone network is further improved. Therefore, compared with the original DETR network, the identification accuracy and model accuracy of the small target in the target detection task are improved effectively. For the target detection task of multi-small targets in complex environment, through the comparison experiment with the current mainstream target detection model, it is proved that the algorithm can effectively improve the accuracy and recognition accuracy of the model for small targets.

articleTitle: YOLO-GFD: A Fast and Accurate Fabric Defect Detection Model
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Fabric defect detection plays a pivotal role in ensuring quality management within the textile industry, enabling timely identification and remediation of defects. This research addresses key challenges in fabric defect detection, including slow detection speed, significant variations in defect scale, and the difficulty in detecting small defects. To tackle these challenges, this study presents the “Yolo-GFD” fabric defect detection model, a refined version of YOLO5, designed to strike a harmonious balance between detection speed and accuracy. Firstly, “G-bottleneck” is utilized instead of the original bottleneck module in the backbone and neck network, which greatly reduces the parameters of the model and improves the detection speed. In addition, we design a new feature fusion network that better fuses features across scales and effectively enhances the detection of small targets. Finally, we use the k-means algorithm to design a priori frames suitable for fabric blemish detection and introduce the feature enhancement module “DSE-Block” behind the backbone network to make our detection model more adaptable to the scale variation of fabric blemishes. Experimental results on the dataset used in this paper show that compared with the original algorithm, the mean average precision (map) is dramatically improved by 6.72%, and the detection speed reaches 22. 39 fps, which effectively meets the requirements of real-time defect detection in industrial environments.

articleTitle: Degradation Adaption Based Heterogeneous Face Hallucination
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: In real-world long-range surveillance systems, thermal face images captured from a distance suffer from low resolution and noise, posing challenges for thermal-to-visible face image translation. Current methods assume similar resolutions and noise-free conditions between thermal and visible images, limiting their applicability. To address these issues, we propose the Degradation Adaption Network (DANet), which synthesizes high-quality visible images from low-quality thermal images. DANet combines pretrained Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) blocks with a U-shaped deep neural network (DNN) to incorporate faithful facial priors, including geometry, facial textures, and colors. Additionally, an unsupervised degradation representation learning scheme is developed to capture abstract degradation representations of degraded thermal images in a representation space. This approach allows DANet to adapt spatial features based on the degradation representation, striking a balance between fidelity and texture faithfulness using degradation-aware feature fusion (DAFF) blocks. Experimental results demonstrate that DANet outperforms state-of-the-art methods, showing its effectiveness in handling real-world low-quality thermal images across diverse practical applications.

articleTitle: Utilizing Large Language Models for the Generation of Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis Datasets
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: With the rapid development of the field of Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis (ABSA), the importance of Data Set(DS)labeling for training high-quality ABSA models has become increasingly prominent. In the past, the ABSA DS labeling task was usually handed over to crowd workers on the MTurk platform or expert classifiers, but with the development of Large Language Models(LLMs) in natural Language generation tasks, it shows great potential in data labeling. In this paper, we propose a sentiment analysis framework that automatically acquires labeled MOOC’s DS to evaluate the accuracy, reliability, and bias of LLMs in ABSA text analysis tasks compared to manual ones. The results show that ChatGPT is superior to humans in ABSA labeling tasks, the zero-sample accuracy and code-to-code consistency both exceed crowdsourced workers. These findings show that LLMs do have the potential to be used for dataset labeling tasks, and can provide a new feasible idea for future DS labeling research in the ABSA field.

articleTitle: Improvement of Packet Loss Concealment for EVS Codec Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: With the advancement of network technology, real-time communication has become an integral part of daily life. However, packet loss presents a significant challenge to the quality of real-time communication. The Enhanced Voice Services (EVS) codec includes an inherent Linear Prediction (LP)-based packet loss concealment system to mitigate the effects of packet loss, but this system exhibits noticeable limitations concerning voice quality and resilience during severe packet loss scenarios. In this paper, we propose an enhancement to the EVS’s PLC performance using a Generative Adversarial Network (GAN)-based deep learning model. This model employs a generator with an asymmetric causal convolutional network and a multi-resolution discriminator for lost speech reconstruction. Experimental results show that the proposed system outperforms the inherent PLC system of the EVS codec in terms of Perceptual Evaluation of Speech Quality (PESQ), Short Time Object Intelligibility (STOI) and PLCMOS. Additionally, subjective listening tests following the MUSHRA standard further confirmed the improvement in speech quality.

articleTitle: MonoDet-K: A Monocular 3D Object Detector on BEV with Keypoint Regression
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Autonomous driving necessitates solving the challenging task of monocular 3D object detection, where the goal is to infer accurate 3D predictions solely from a single 2D image. Existing approaches typically rely on conventional 2D object detectors to localize objects based on their centers and predict 3D attributes using neighboring features around these centers. However, this local feature-based approach falls short in comprehending scene-level 3D spatial structures and neglects crucial inter-object depth relations inferred from contextual cues. At the same time, Transformer-based methods usually ignore geometry relationship. In response, this paper introduces MonoDet-K, a transformer based 3D detector with camera-based keypoint regression. In this network, 3D object candidates are represented as a set of queries, and a depth-aware encoder uses attention mechanisms to generate non-local depth embeddings of the input image. Our proposed depth-guided decoder incorporates depth cross-attention modules, facilitating both inter-query and query-scene depth feature interactions. Consequently, each object query can adaptively estimate its 3D attributes by leveraging depth-guided regions from the image, unbound by the limitation of relying solely on neighboring visual features. MonoDet-K is designed as an end-to-end network, eliminating the need for additional data. Remarkably, it achieves state-of-the-art performance on the KITTI benchmark, showcasing significant improvements. Through extensive ablation studies, we demonstrate the efficacy of our approach, underscoring its potential to serve as a transformer-based baseline for future research in monocular 3D object detection. The proposed framework represents a substantial step forward in addressing the challenges of monocular 3D object detection and opens new avenues for advancing this critical field in autonomous driving.

articleTitle: A Study on Improving the Golden Jackal Optimization Algorithm to Solve the Flexible Workshop Scheduling Problem
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: This study present an improved golden jackal optimization algorithm (IGJO) to address the flexible job shop scheduling problem (FJSP) with the primary purpose of maximizing minimization. The study employs a two-stage coding approach to establish the connection between the algorithm and scheduling. Additionally, an elite reverse strategy is employed to enhance the quality of the initial solution. Furthermore, a nonlinear convergence factor is introduced to ensure a balanced search function of the algorithm. In the position update phase, a position update method based on the fitness value is proposed. Finally, the effectiveness of the IGJO algorithm in addressing the FJSP problem is verified through a benchmark example.

articleTitle: Federated News Recommendation Model Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: The objective of the News Recommendation System (NRS) is to match news representations with the interests of users, which are learned from their past interactions with news. However, current NRS methods primarily focus on storing user behavior data, which raises concerns regarding privacy. In this study, we present an approach for safeguarding the privacy of news recommendations using federated learning. This method avoids the centralized storage of user behavior data by storing it locally on each user’s device, reducing privacy risks. By leveraging collaborative learning, we can train accurate news recommendation models using a large number of user devices. The actions performed by users on their devices provide valuable insights, and the model gradient is computed based on these local actions. The gradient computed for the chosen user is transmitted to the server for the purpose of updating the global model. This updated global model is then sent back to each user for them to perform local model updates. To enhance user privacy, we incorporate local differential privacy, which randomizes the gradient before uploading it to the server. Empirical findings based on real-world datasets illustrate the effectiveness of our approach in achieving a harmonious balance between recommendation performance and user privacy.

articleTitle: Prediction of TBM Tunneling Parameters Based on RF
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: With the continuous proficiency of TBM technology, predicting and optimizing TBM performance becomes increasingly important. Due to the complexity and difficulty in predicting geological conditions, it is preferred to adjust key excavation parameters based on measured data. This paper takes the TBM3 bid section excavation data of Jilin YS project as the research object, introduces knowledge driven vectors TPI and FPI, integrates time series into the random forest algorithm (RF), and utilizes the TBM circular tunneling process start-up loading and stably advancing segments excavation parameters to establish a cutter head thrust and torque prediction model. The results show that the introduction of TPI and FPI keeps the input and output of the model consistent, achieving the goal of simplifying the algorithm; The evaluation indicators R and R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> for predicting cutter head thrust and cutter head torque are both above 0.8, with high prediction accuracy.

articleTitle: A Semantic Communication Method for Transmitting 2D Human Body Image Information
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: In this paper, a 2D human target semantic communication method based on deep learning and Transformer model is proposed. First, convolutional neural network and Region Proposal Network are used for human target detection and segmentation, and the segmented human targets and their unique segmentation masks are obtained. Then, a Transformer-based semantic coder is designed to encode the human target pixel data while preserving the key information of the human target. The encoding process includes image cutting into patches, linear mapping and adding position encoding, which is then encoded by Transformer model. At the receiving end, the semantic information is decoded by designing a semantic decoder, followed by patch mapping and image reconstruction to achieve decoding the semantic data into human target images. The simulation results show that this method achieves a certain effect in realizing the semantic encoding transmission and decoding reconstruction of human target.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a Security Component Sharing Mechanism for Iot Cloud Platform
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: With the continuous development of software engineering, a large number of functions that used to be completed by hardware are now controlled and completed by software. Iot cloud platforms are also increasingly dependent on software. Once the software fails or runs abnormally, the system failure caused by it may directly lead to the hardware failure, resulting in serious security problems. Under the premise of ensuring functional safety, the software of the Iot cloud platform should meet the reusability of the code and meet the needs of the rapid development of the Iot cloud platform through modularization and componentization. This paper designs a security component sharing strategy for the Iot cloud platform, which avoids some common problems caused by traditional access control strategies while realizing dynamic and flexible identity management, and reduces certain economic and social costs.

articleTitle: Piano Wooden Parts Paint Surface Defect Detection based on YOLO
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: To solve the problem of difficult detection and missed detection of small and low-information targets in piano paint surface defect detection, an improved YOLOv5 piano paint surface defect detection algorithm is proposed. The algorithm builds a defect recognition and labeling model. First, perform data augmentation on the original image. Then, add the CA attention mechanism to the YOLOv5 backbone network to focus on defect information. Finally, improve the upsampling operator in the neck network and replace the original loss function with DIoU to improve the detection effect. Experimental results show that this defect detection model not only improves the detection accuracy in general, but also effectively improves the recognition accuracy of small targets and low-information targets that are difficult to detect and prone to missed detection, such as surface roughness, bubbles, and garbage hole eyes, achieving better detection effect.

articleTitle: An Improved Shallow Feature Extraction Structure and Fused Attention Module for Aided Diagnosis of Avionic Electrical Fault Phenomena Method
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: In order to solve the current aviation maintenance and troubleshooting reliance on aircraft manuals, we proposed an idea of using aircraft fault panel images to derive the corresponding manual work card numbers and adopted an image recognition method to achieve aided diagnosis of electrical fault phenomena. To improve the diagnosis efficiency, we proposed an Enhanced Spatial and Channel Attention (ESCA) module, and then improved the shallow feature extraction module of ResNet18, which includes replacing the first layer convolution with the dilated convolution, removing the max pooling layer, and improving the residual structure in the first block. To ensure the stability during training, we used the learning rate decay strategy of Cosine Annealing. In order to verify the effectiveness of the ideas and methods proposed, we set up several sets of comparison and ablation experiments. The results show that the model performance can be significantly improved by 4.3% while the parameters is reduced by about 1.35% using our method.

articleTitle: A New Method for Comparing the Difficulties of Chinese Texts Based on Natural Language Processing Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Research on the difficulty comparison of different Chinese texts involves multiple fields. Some commonly used methods: Vocabulary Complexity Analysis, Grammar and Semantic Complexity Analysis, Theme and Domain Specialization Analysis, etc. The article attempts to explore a new method for comparing text difficulty by calculating the numerical value of mean dependency distance (MDD). Research analysis: The higher the MDD value, the greater the difficulty of the text; The difficulty of the textbook text increases as the order increases, which also means that the difficulty of the text gradually increases; The difficulty level of Chinese texts in different periods is around the average of 3.662, which also indicates that the MDD value of Chinese texts is higher than that of other languages, and there is statistical support for the higher difficulty level of Chinese texts compared to other languages.

articleTitle: A Reliability Evaluation Model for Smart Meters Based on Survival Analysis Theory
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Smarter meter is one kind of electronic meter with multiple functions such as remote control, anomaly monitoring, edge computing, etc. Smarter meter is the basic unit of the energy metering system and the perception terminal of the electricity information collection system. The large quantity also brings difficulties while smart meters are widely deployed on the user side. Aiming at reducing the human and material resources which are spent on maintaining smart meters, A reliability evaluation model for smart meters based on multivariate big data fusion is built to evaluate smart meters’ operational reliability. Multivariate big data is merged and collated to obtain the covariate data and the smart meter survival label that affect the life span of smart meters. Based on the survival analysis theory, a cox proportional-hazards(CoxPH) model for the life cycle of a smart meter is established, and a deep neural network is used to characterize strongly non-linear correlation parameters to form a reliability evaluation model for the smart meter. Based on the actual operation and maintenance data of smart meters of some city, the effectiveness of the proposed model is verified. Test results show that the proposed model, which provides subsidiarity for smart meter maintenance, and can estimate reliability of the smart meter successfully based on its real-time running status.

articleTitle: A Clustered Routing Protocol for Ensuring Structural Stability of Clusters in WSN
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: To improve the cluster structure stability of WSN in data transmission, the clustering routing protocol (LEACH-ESTD) proposed in this paper is based on the self-checking and active switching of cluster head nodes. Firstly, the protocol used a global fitness function and an independent node judgment function to initialize network cluster allocation, reducing the randomness of cluster head selection and guaranteeing stable cluster structure. Secondly, the protocol evaluated the cluster structure periodically through a cluster head self-test algorithm to detect pre-damaged cluster head nodes promptly. Finally, the protocol adopted a cluster head alternative and switching technique to replace the pre-damaged cluster head and improve the stability of the cluster structure. The findings from the simulation demonstrate that the algorithm has stronger cluster structure stability and longer network lifespan than the LEACH, EIP-LEACH, ENERGY-LEACH, and ILEACH protocols.

articleTitle: An Optimized Lightweight Crop Pest Detection Method
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: The practical application of crop pest detection methods has been limited by the large number of parameters and computations, and we built a lightweight crop pest detection method YOLOLite-CSG in our previous research, which basically removed this limitation. However, further analysis shows that YOLOLite-CSG still has problems that affect the performance in terms of the prior box generation method, downsampling method and bounding box regression loss function. In response to these problems, this paper proposes the prior box generation method based on label box oversampling and clustering (BS-Medians), the downsampling method based on parallel feature transformation (PSPD-Conv), and the bounding box regression loss function with size difference optimization capability (FIoU Loss). We optimize YOLOLite-CSG using the above methods to build YOLOLite-X, an optimized lightweight crop pest detection method. The experiment results show that YOLOLite-X exceeds YOLOLite-CSG in crop pest detection precision and is higher than other state-of-the-art methods. Meanwhile, YOLOLite- X has a smaller number of parameters and computations, which is more conducive to practical deployment and application.

articleTitle: Graph Convolutional Networks with Sliding Window Attention for Skeleton-Based Action Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Graph Convolutional Networks (GCNs) have been widely applied and achieved significant results in skeleton-based action recognition. However, existing methods mostly focus on modeling static spatial features of the skeleton structure, while overlooking the highly coordinated temporal and spatial relationships among joints. In this work, we propose Sliding Window Attention Graph Convolution (SWAGC) method which introduces local sliding windows to expand spatial feature extraction in the temporal dimension and propagates joint features to capture key joint information in different temporal periods. Furthermore, to better model temporal dynamics, we introduce Global Multi-Scale Temporal Convolution (GMSTC). GMSTC combines multi-scale temporal convolutions with self-attention mechanism to extract global multi-scale temporal dynamics and enhance the modeling capability for different types of actions. Combining SWAGC and GMSTC, we develop a graph convolutional network named SWA-GCN, which achieves performance comparable to state-of-the-art methods on 3 main stream datasets: NTU RGB+D, NTU RGB+D 120, and NW-UCLA.

articleTitle: TransFTTA: A Knowledge Representation Learning Model Based on Flexible Translation and Temporal Attributes
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Knowledge graph is a structured semantic knowledge base that has gained widespread application across diverse domains. Nevertheless, traditional models for knowledge graph representation learning, such as TransE and TransH, exhibit constraints in terms of representation capacity and accuracy when it comes to tasks like link prediction and triple classification. To overcome these issues and further enhance the performance of knowledge graph representation models, this study introduces a knowledge representation learning model based on dynamic translation and temporal attributes. The experimental findings substantiate that our proposed model exhibits a significant improvement in performance compared to the TransE and TransH models.

articleTitle: Research on Optimization of Grey Wolf Algorithm with Multiple Improved Strategies
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: The Grey Wolf Optimizer (GWO) boasts remarkable optimization characteristics and is already widely applied across various domains. This paper provides an overview of the enhancements applied to the GWO, meticulously selecting nine of the most representative strategies for improvement. Subsequently, these strategies were subjected to numerical experiments using benchmark functions. The experimental results showed that: the improved grey wolf optimizer (ODGWO) with novel opposition-learning and differential mutation, exhibited superior capabilities in exploration and convergence; The strategy of amalgamating the Grey Wolf Optimizer with Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) in the PSOGWO approach, and the integration with the Whale Optimization Algorithm (WOA) in the WOAGWO approach, notably enhanced the algorithm’s search performance. Of particular note is the fusion with the Whale Optimization Algorithm (WOAGWO), which effectively balanced the trade-off between exploration, exploitation, and the ability to evade local optima, particularly in solving fixed-dimension multimodal benchmark functions.
